# cloudflare_ai_security (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cloudflare_ai_security" "example_ai_security" {
  zone_id = "023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353"
  enabled = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `zone_id` (String) Defines the zone.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether AI Security for Apps is enabled on the zone.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Defines the zone.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
$ terraform import cloudflare_ai_security.example '<zone_id>'
```
